packageRules.description: Every update opens a pull request at once, without dashboard approval. A rule on all packages, because repository rules come after the global ones and override an approval gate set there.
Renovate reads the version input of zizmor-action as the image ghcr.io/zizmorcore/zizmor. The action accepts only a plain X.Y.Z version, so this dependency is never pinned by digest.
zizmor-action runs only the zizmor versions listed in its own release. The action and the zizmor version travel in one pull request.
